cards.title: Who is buying coupon-bearing JGBs?
cards.description: Rolling five calendar month net purchases, yen trillion; displayed since 2022. Latest all coupon-bearing totals — City banks & long-term credit banks: +0.11; Foreign investors: +5.53; Life & non-life insurers: +2.42; Others (JSDA category): -25.75; Regional banks: +2.15; Trust banks: +7.77. Super-long-, long- and medium-term maturity groups are shown separately. Nominal/face value; excludes Treasury bills and discount bonds. Others (JSDA category) uses the six directly reported Others purchase/sale series, not overall minus the displayed sectors. This mixed category includes government auction allocations, BoJ operations and other institutions. It is not pure BoJ activity or aggregate private investor demand. Net purchases are purchases minus sales from the investor/counterparty perspective.
